title: A cleaner, more current public surface
summary:
A small documentation sweep: fewer stale references, less archaeological software marketing.

Old references to gptimage and tier announcements were removed, keeping public-facing copy aligned with the project as it exists now.

highlights.title: New AI Models
highlights.text: Added support for **GPT-5 Nano**, **Claude 3.5 Haiku**, **OpenAI o3**, and **Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite** to the [Text API](https://enter.pollinations.ai).

highlights.title: Usage Statistics API
highlights.text: New endpoint to track hourly token usage, costs, and request counts with detailed filtering options. Check the [API Docs](https://enter.pollinations.ai/api/docs).
